budget.rationale: The published budget, unreduced. A sample is one generated equation program, and samples_per_prompt is 4 with batch inference, so 10000 samples is about 2500 requests per task. Over the six main-body cells and three repetitions that is 180000 samples and roughly 45000 requests, which this hardware can serve. Running the full 40-cell design at this budget would be 1.2 million samples, so the scope is reduced rather than the method's own search, and no budget qualification applies to what is reported.

prompt_policy.description: LLM-SR specifications natively embed a problem description, so supplying the public task specification matches its own protocol.

scope_note: The six cells the method campaign itself reports in the main body. LLM-SR's published datasets ship a precomputed derivative column, so the estimator is ours to choose either way; the fourth-order central difference is shared with the LLM-ODE campaign so a difference between the two baselines cannot be an artefact of different derivative quality.
